detail.longDescription: Your AI agent can brainstorm captions, reword a post for LinkedIn, and sum up what people are saying about your launch. Then the chat ends, and the posting, the replying, and the resharing are back on your plate. Now you can start social media automation from the AI tool you already use. Install Zapier in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor, describe what should happen across your channels, and your agent builds it as a Zap. Zapier takes over from there and keeps it running long after the chat is closed.
